project: GroupPass verified attraction and group-pricing database
method: Existing curated records remain trusted seed data. New attraction candidates are discovered through free Wikimedia APIs, then accepted only when an official venue website confirms a group program. Current group pages are rechecked directly from official venue sources. No paid search API or API key is required. The website suppresses stale exact rates until they are reverified.
activationRequired: None. The GitHub Action can run without paid API keys or repository secrets.
